title: Professional 2026-09-20 — PLC subroutines and parameter passing
goal: Represent continuous and periodic tasks, conditional subroutine calls, input/return parameters and one-shot decrement. Preserve the generated approximation so missing instruction semantics can be assessed.

rubric.must: R_Calc and R_Decr calls are represented as subroutine operations with their required parameters; an output coil merely labelled JSR does not meet this requirement.
The continuous and 10 ms periodic task boundaries, one-shot decrement and arithmetic operations remain identifiable.
Instruction operands, rung comments and tag names are fully visible without overlaps or clipping.

provenance.notes: Selected against a real first user request. Source defects are intentionally preserved. Project identity is removed; no customer IDs or private prompt text are included. These are evaluation inputs, not approved professional reference designs. Full conversation changes and domain behavior require separate review.
